page_title: JUV 4-1 EMP | Juventus v Empoli 02/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' 4 - 1 Goal! Khephren Thuram puts a cross into the box and finds Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 4:1.
90+2' Here comes a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito is given a rest as he is replaced by Ismael Konate (Empoli).
90+2' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Liam Henderson will be replaced by Jacopo Bacci (Empoli).
90+1' Substitution. Lorenzo Tosto (Empoli) in, Luca Marianucci out.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 1 Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!
89' Liam Henderson (Empoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
88' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nicolas Gonzalez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus).
85' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Weston McKennie is replaced by Khephren Thuram (Juventus).
84' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
84' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

82' Ambitious effort from Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
82' Empoli fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.

81' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The linesman points to the corner flag, Empoli are going to take it.
81' The referee blows his whistle as Federico Gatti (Juventus) was too aggressive in his challenge. Empoli have been awarded a free kick.
78' Renato Veiga (Juventus) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Zufferli no option but to blow his whistle. Empoli have a free kick.
75' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
75' Liam Henderson (Empoli) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

74' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Empoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
73' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) plays a through ball but overhits it.
72' Liam Henderson (Empoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Michele Di Gregorio makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!

67' The free kick from a promising distance is taken by Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
66' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Empoli is cautioned for aggressive play. Juventus are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
65' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) replaces Kenan Yildiz.
64' 2 - 1 Goal! Timothy Weah slips a clever pass through to Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus), who moves inside the box and sends a measured shot beyond the keeper and into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
61' 1 - 1 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
61' A lofted cross from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
61' The resulting corner from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

60' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. Juventus win a corner.
59' Roberto D'Aversa is forced to make a change. Ardian Ismajli is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Saba Goglichidze (Empoli).
59' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) plants a nice towering header goalwards, but one of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital clearance.
58' The game is interrupted now, Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

56' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the top of the net, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach keeps the ball out.

56' Liam Henderson (Empoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Zufferli with no other option than to blow for a foul. It's a free kick to Juventus, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

55' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
55' Corner kick. Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is ready to send the ball into the box.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.

54' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball goes out of play and Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
52' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
52' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Liam Henderson (Empoli). Luca Zufferli saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick to Juventus.

51' A clever short pass gives Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
50' The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' Faustino Anjorin is being substituted because of an injury. Roberto D'Aversa sends Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) on the pitch.
48' Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45+1' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
45+1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach comes off the line to clear the ball away.
43' Federico Gatti (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
42' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
41' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) sees a yellow card from Luca Zufferli after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
40' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. A free kick has been awarded to Empoli.
40' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) commits a rough foul. Luca Zufferli stops the game and makes a call. That's a free kick to Empoli.
39' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
38' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) on the edge of the box.
37' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Luca Zufferli ignores the protests.
36' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli earn a free kick.
35' Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
34' Luca Zufferli blows his whistle and it's Federico Gatti (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. It's a free kick to Empoli in a dangerous position.
34' Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.

34' Weston McKennie (Juventus) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
32' A poorly executed mid-range free kick by Liberato Cacace (Empoli) as he fails to deliver a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
32' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) brings his opponent down. Luca Zufferli has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Empoli.

31' Close! Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
30' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
29' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Juventus are awarded a free kick.
28' Referee Luca Zufferli sees the trip by Faustino Anjorin (Empoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Juventus.
27' Ardian Ismajli (Empoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Juventus are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
25' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. Juventus have a free kick.

25' What a chance that is! Timothy Weah (Juventus) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
24' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

24' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the top of the net. Devis Stiven Vasquez Llach is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
23' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
23' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Juventus manage to earn a corner.
22' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lorenzo Colombo (Empoli) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
20' Empoli concede a free kick following a bad challenge. There is a free kick near the sideline to Juventus.
18' The Empoli players can’t believe it after referee Luca Zufferli signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
17' There's a break in play and referee Luca Zufferli must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Empoli using VAR. This could be interesting!
16' Michele Di Gregorio (Juventus) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle for a foul. Empoli are awarded a penalty!

15' Luca Zufferli interrupts the game. One of the players from Empoli won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Juventus win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
15' The resulting corner from Liam Henderson (Empoli) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

14' Sebastiano Esposito (Empoli) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Empoli.
14' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) will deliver the corner kick.
12' Timothy Weah (Juventus) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
12' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
10' A player from Juventus commits a rough challenge. Luca Zufferli blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Empoli will take a free kick.
10' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.

4' 0 - 1 Mattia De Sciglio (Empoli) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner kick and scores with a great header aimed low into the middle of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is 0:1.
4' Liam Henderson (Empoli) steps up to send the ball in.
4' Liam Henderson (Empoli) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The referee signals a corner kick to Empoli.
1' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
